findings.text: red-team lens, medium: The `latest` symlink is dereferenced twice in separate reads: once at line 1842 for issue discovery (through `$_ls_sd/pipeline-state.json`) and again at line 2245 (`readlink -f "$state_dir/latest"`) for auto-resume resolution; a concurrent pipeline run that atomically replaces the `latest` symlink between those two reads causes `issue` (governs template and goal lookup) to be sourced from one run's state while `state_dir`, `state_file`, and `_runner_issue` are sourced from a different run's state, producing a cross-run identity mismatch. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1842; fix: code)

red-team lens, medium: The DSRHYD-2 fail-closed contract (a complete stage with an absent artifact must exit 1) is bypassed when the stage's plugin directory cannot be located or the manifest declares no primary artifact: both cases fall through to `info "Skipping already-complete stage"` and `continue` without any artifact check, so a complete stage with a missing artifact is silently skipped rather than causing the required exit 1. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3855; fix: code)

red-team lens, medium: When `_TPL_CYCLE_STAGES_<id>` is unset or empty, `IFS=',' read -ra _dc_members <<< ""` produces a single-element array containing the empty string; the `[[ -z "$_dc_m" ]] && continue` guard fires for that element, and the loop exits without verifying any member artifact, so a complete cycle whose stage-list variable is empty is silently skipped instead of triggering exit 1. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3537; fix: code)
